_description: Block edits to sensitive files (env, credentials, secrets, production configs)
_usage: Merge into .claude/settings.json - exit code 2 blocks the tool
_requires: python3 (falls back to allow with warning if unavailable); .claude/hooks/scripts/protected-files.{sh,py} -- without them every write is blocked with a message (just hooks-templates-update brings them)
_protected_patterns: .env files: every name starting with .env (.env, .envrc, .env-prod, .env.local, .env/), and .env as a suffix or infix (app.env, config.env.local)

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/scripts/protected-files.sh"; [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "BLOCKED: protected-files hook script missing: $f (run just hooks-templates-update)" >&2; exit 2; }; bash "$f"
